description: Replace the 5-role system with the 3-role marketplace model (Seller, Buyer, Weigher) AND give each role its own tailored dashboard with DashboardShell routing by role, including a new Weigher verification/valuation step in the trade flow. This covers Task Parts 1 and 2 together because they share the same files (AuthContext, DashboardShell, OverviewPage, WasteMarketPage, TradingContext, landingData, landing sections, RegisterPage role options). Role mapping: reporter+waste_sourcer -> seller; hub_operator -> weigher; recycler -> buyer; admin removed (no 4th role). Marketplace flow: Seller lists -> Weigher verifies -> Buyer purchases. NOTE: the baseline `npm run build` currently FAILS with 31 pre-existing TS errors, ALL in files this FEAT modifies (DashboardShell, AuthContext, OverviewPage, WasteMarketPage, RegisterPage). Root causes: (a) icon-typed fields use `React.FC<{size?:number;strokeWidth?:number;className?:string}>` which is incompatible with Lucide's ForwardRefExoticComponent (size is string|number) -> fix by typing those fields as `LucideIcon` from 'lucide-react'; (b) unused locals/params/imports. The rewritten files MUST compile cleanly so the Definition-of-Done 'build passes' is met. Keep the `sourcerId/sourcerName/sourcerRegion` field names in TradingContext and consumers (they denote the listing Seller; they are NOT old role identifiers and are not grep targets) — only update the 'SOURCER:' code comments to 'SELLER:'.
steps: 1. src/context/AuthContext.tsx: change `export type UserRole` to `| 'seller' | 'buyer' | 'weigher'`. Rename `interface RecyclerProfile` to `interface BuyerProfile` (same fields). In `User`, rename field `recyclerProfile?: RecyclerProfile` to `buyerProfile?: BuyerProfile` and update the `approved` comment (remove 'hub_operator / admin / waste_sourcer need approval' — write a neutral comment). In `RegisterPayload`, rename `recyclerProfile?: RecyclerProfile` to `buyerProfile?: BuyerProfile`. In the simulated `login()`, change the demo user `role: 'reporter'` to `role: 'seller'` (keep approved:true). In `register`, the `data` param is currently unused (TS6133): rename the implementation parameter to `_data` (the AuthContextValue interface still declares `(data: RegisterPayload)`) — do NOT add persistence logic. Update the `// Extra profile fields shown only when role === 'recycler'` comment to reference 'buyer'.
2. src/components/ui/Icon.tsx: add `Scale` to the lucide-react import list and to the `icons` map object (used for the Weigher). Do not remove any existing icons.

3. src/data/landingData.ts: (a) Replace the `roles` array (6 entries) with exactly 3, in this order: {icon:'Package', name:'Seller', desc:'Source of waste — list the marine waste you have collected or hold, track your listings, and earn Blue Credits for verified material.'}, {icon:'Recycle', name:'Buyer', desc:'Recycling company or processor — browse verified recovered materials and purchase them for reuse.'}, {icon:'Scale', name:'Weigher', desc:'Neutral third party — weigh waste, confirm its value, and turn a listing into verified material before it is sold.'}. (b) Rewrite `journeySteps` (7 steps) to the marketplace flow using ONLY icon names that exist in Icon.tsx: 1 List (MessageSquarePlus) 'Sellers post waste they have collected or hold — photo, type, estimated weight, and general area.'; 2 Assess (ScanSearch) 'AI-assisted categorization helps sort and prioritize listings for verification.'; 3 Verify (Scale) 'A Weigher weighs the waste and confirms the valuation — a listing alone never counts as sold material.'; 4 Purchase (Store) 'Buyers browse verified material and purchase recovered resources for recycling.'; 5 Reward (Coins) 'Blue Credits are calculated from the Weigher-verified weight using transparent, configured rules.'; 6 Reuse (Leaf) 'Recovered materials connect to recyclers and processors through the Circular Marketplace.'; 7 Impact (BarChart3) 'Verified kilograms, trades, and community participation are tracked end to end.' (c) In `features`, update only the two entries that name old roles: the 'Verified Collection Records' desc -> 'Every collection is weighed and confirmed by a Weigher, creating an auditable record. The system enforces the distinction between listed and verified material.'; the 'Blue Credits Ledger' desc -> 'Transparent incentive points calculated from Weigher-verified weight using transparent, configured rules. Full transaction history with rate disclosure on every entry.' (d) In `circularItems`, update only item[0] 'Plastic Recovery' desc: replace 'through hub verification' with 'through Weigher verification' (keep the rest). Leave impactStats and the 'other'/'Unsure' waste concept untouched.

4. src/components/sections/RolesSection.tsx: change the grid container `xl:grid-cols-6` to `xl:grid-cols-3` so the 3 role cards fill nicely (keep sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3). The section consumes `roles` from landingData — no other change.

5. src/components/sections/HeroSection.tsx: update the hero paragraph (the line reading 'Aquasource Hub connects coastal communities, cleanup collectors, and recyclers ...') to 'Aquasource Hub connects coastal communities, sellers, weighers, and buyers through AI-assisted hotspot mapping, verified collection records, and transparent Blue Credits — building a cleaner, circular blue economy.' (remove 'cleanup collectors').

6. src/components/sections/FeaturesSection.tsx: update the subtitle line 'Built for coastal communities, coordinators, hub operators, and recyclers —' to 'Built for coastal communities, sellers, weighers, and buyers —' (remove coordinators and hub operators).

7. src/components/sections/JourneySection.tsx: update the heading 'From Report to Reuse — Every Step Verified' to 'From Listing to Reuse — Every Step Verified'. The section consumes journeySteps from landingData — no other change.

8. src/components/sections/AuthCTASection.tsx: (a) signInFeatures -> ['Role-based dashboard tailored to your work', 'Real-time waste listings and trade updates', 'Verified collection history and Blue Credits', 'Notifications for new listings and verification tasks']. (b) registerFeatures -> ['Choose your role and operating region', 'Verify your account before you start', 'List, verify, or purchase waste material', 'Earn Blue Credits for verified waste']. (c) Replace the heading paragraph ending 'privileged access is reviewed by administrators.' with 'every account is verified before it is activated.' (d) Replace the Register card paragraph 'Join as a reporter, collector, hub operator, coordinator, or recycler. Free to join.' with 'Join as a Seller, Buyer, or Weigher. Free to join.'

9. src/components/dashboard/DashboardShell.tsx: (a) Replace `ROLE_LABELS` with exactly { seller:'Seller', buyer:'Buyer', weigher:'Weigher' }. (b) Change the `NavItem` interface `icon` type from `React.FC<{size?:number;strokeWidth?:number;className?:string}>` to `LucideIcon` (add `LucideIcon` to the lucide-react import; remove the now-unused `Map, ClipboardList, BarChart3` imports and add `Scale`). (c) Replace `getNavItems` with 3 cases (each returns, no fallthrough): seller -> [...base, listings, credits, settings] where listings={icon:Search,label:'My Listings',path:'/dashboard/market'}; buyer -> [...base, market, credits, settings] where market={icon:Store,label:'Waste Market',path:'/dashboard/market'}; weigher -> [...base, verify, credits, settings] where verify={icon:Scale,label:'Verifications',path:'/dashboard/market'}; default -> [...base, market, settings]. Keep base=[{icon:LayoutDashboard,label:'Overview',path:'/dashboard'}], credits={icon:Coins,label:'Blue Credits',path:'/dashboard/credits'}, settings={icon:Settings,label:'Settings',path:'/dashboard/settings'}. (d) Change the fallback in `const navItems = getNavItems(user?.role ?? 'reporter')` to `?? 'seller'`. No other changes to the shell chrome.

10. src/context/TradingContext.tsx: (a) Add 'verified' to `ListingStatus` (after 'available'): `| 'verified' // weighed + valued by a Weigher, ready for buyer purchase`. (b) Add 'weight_verified' to `TradeEventType`. (c) Add optional fields to `WasteListing`: `verifiedWeight?: number`, `verifiedTotal?: number`, `weigherId?: string`, `weigherName?: string`, `verifiedAt?: string`. (d) Add to `TradingContextValue` interface and the provider value a new action `verifyListing: (id: string, weigherId: string, weigherName: string, verifiedWeight: number) => void`. (e) Implement `verifyListing` with useCallback: set the listing's verifiedWeight, verifiedTotal=verifiedWeight*pricePerKg, weigherId, weigherName, verifiedAt=now(), status='verified', append timeline event('weight_verified', weigherId, weigherName, `Verified ${verifiedWeight} kg — Value: ₦${verifiedTotal}`), and addNotification({type:'system', title:'✅ Material Verified', body:`${weigherName} verified ${verifiedWeight} kg of ${wasteType}.`, listingId}). Read the listing from state for the notification body. Keep the existing confirmInspection buyer action unchanged (buyer confirms at pickup). Update the 'SOURCER:' section comments to 'SELLER:'. Keep `sourcerId/sourcerName/sourcerRegion` field names.

11. src/components/dashboard/CreateListingModal.tsx (NEW): extract the existing CreateListingModal from WasteMarketPage into this shared component, props `{ onClose: () => void }`, using `useAuth().user` and `useTrading().createListing`, identical form fields/validation/payload (sourcerId=user.id, sourcerName=user.fullName, sourcerRegion=user.region). Export it as default. This is a pure move-and-export (same JSX/logic).

12. src/components/dashboard/VerifyListingModal.tsx (NEW): props `{ listing: WasteListing; onClose: () => void }`. Uses `useTrading().verifyListing` and `useAuth().user`. Form with one numeric input 'Verified weight (kg)' defaulting to `String(listing.estimatedWeight)`, a read-only preview of verified total = verifiedWeight * listing.pricePerKg, and a 'Confirm Verification' button that calls `verifyListing(listing.id, user.id, user.fullName, +verifiedWeight)` then onClose(). Validate weight > 0. Match the dark glass styling of CreateListingModal (bg #0B2233, teal accents, XCircle close).

13. src/pages/dashboard/SellerDashboard.tsx (NEW): export default. Wraps content in `<DashboardShell title='Overview' subtitle={greeting + ', ' + user.firstName}>`. Focus: listing waste for sale + tracking listings + credits. Show a 4-card stat grid (reuse the StatCard pattern from the old OverviewPage — define a local StatCard with `icon: LucideIcon`): My Listings (myListings.length), Active Trades (active where sourcerId===user.id), Completed (completed where sourcerId===user.id), Blue Credits (sum blueCreditsEarned). If totalEarned>0 show the teal earnings banner. Show 'My Recent Listings' (myListings) with a 'Post Waste' button that opens `<CreateListingModal>` (local showCreate state), and a 'View all' link to /dashboard/market. Each listing row navigates to /dashboard/market. Compute myListings=listings.filter(l=>l.sourcerId===user.id), active=['reserved','inspecting','payment_pending','verified'], completed=['completed']. Import icons from lucide-react (Package, Clock, CheckCircle2, Coins, TrendingUp, ArrowRight, Plus).

14. src/pages/dashboard/BuyerDashboard.tsx (NEW): export default. Wraps in DashboardShell('Overview', greeting). Focus: browsing + purchasing available materials. 4-card stat grid: Available Waste (listings where status==='available' OR 'verified'), Active Trades (myPurchases active), Completed Buys (myPurchases completed), Total Spent (sum agreedTotal of completed myPurchases). Show 'Available Now' list (verified + available listings) each row shows wasteType, weight, location, sourcerName, price; clicking navigates to /dashboard/market. Add a 'Browse all' link to /dashboard/market. Import Package, Clock, CheckCircle2, Coins, ArrowRight. myPurchases=listings.filter(l=>l.buyerId===user.id).

15. src/pages/dashboard/WeigherDashboard.tsx (NEW): export default. Wraps in DashboardShell('Overview', greeting). Focus: verification tasks — weighing waste and confirming valuations. 4-card stat grid: Pending Verification (listings where status==='available'), Verified by Me (listings where weigherId===user.id), Total Verified Weight (sum verifiedWeight where weigherId===user.id) kg, Verified Value (sum verifiedTotal where weigherId===user.id) formatted ₦. Show a 'Verification Queue' list of available listings (sorted by createdAt) each with a 'Verify' button that opens `<VerifyListingModal listing={l}>` (local selected state). If the queue is empty show an empty-state. Import Package, Scale, CheckCircle2, Coins. Use useAuth().user and useTrading().listings.

16. src/pages/dashboard/OverviewPage.tsx: refactor into a thin role router. Remove the old StatCard/isSourcer/isRecycler branches and all the inline stats. New body: read `const { user } = useAuth()` then `switch (user?.role) { case 'seller': return <SellerDashboard/>; case 'buyer': return <BuyerDashboard/>; case 'weigher': return <WeigherDashboard/>; default: return <SellerDashboard/> }`. (Each role dashboard renders its own DashboardShell, so OverviewPage itself no longer renders DashboardShell.) Remove now-unused imports (Package, Coins, CheckCircle2, Clock, ArrowRight, TrendingUp, useTrading, useNavigate) to satisfy noUnusedLocals. Keep only useAuth + the 3 dashboard imports.

17. src/pages/dashboard/WasteMarketPage.tsx: (a) Replace `const isSourcer = user?.role === 'waste_sourcer'` with `isSeller = user?.role === 'seller'`; `isRecycler = user?.role === 'recycler'` with `isBuyer = user?.role === 'buyer'`; add `isWeigher = user?.role === 'weigher'`. (b) Change `WASTE_ICONS: Record<WasteType, React.FC<...>>` value type to `LucideIcon` (import type { LucideIcon } from 'lucide-react' or use the value import). (c) Add 'verified' to STATUS_COLORS ('bg-teal/30 text-teal-light border-teal/40' or a distinct teal-strong style) and STATUS_LABELS ('Verified'). (d) Replace the in-file CreateListingModal with an import of the shared `CreateListingModal` from '@/components/dashboard/CreateListingModal' and remove the local definition (delete the local CreateListingModal function to avoid duplication). (e) In ListingDetailModal: rename isSourcer->isSeller, isRecycler->isBuyer, add isWeigher. Add a Weigher action block: when isWeigher && listing.status==='available', render a 'Verify Weight & Valuation' button that opens the VerifyListingModal (render `{selected && <VerifyListingModal .../>}` — or inline a verify step mirroring the inspect step using verifyListing). Allow the buyer 'Express Interest' action when listing.status==='available' OR 'verified' (update the guard from `=== 'available'` to `['available','verified'].includes(listing.status)`). (f) In the main page: show the 'Post Waste' button when isSeller; show the weigher subtitle 'Verify and value incoming waste' when isWeigher; keep the buyer banner when isBuyer. Update the empty-state copy branches to use isSeller/isBuyer. Keep WasteType/WASTE_LABELS/WASTE_ICONS and the 'other' category unchanged.

18. src/pages/RegisterPage.tsx (FEAT-001 scope — role options only; FEAT-002 adds verification): (a) Replace `roleOptions` with exactly 3: {value:'seller', label:'Seller', desc:'Source of waste — list the marine waste you have collected or hold, and sell to buyers.', Icon:Package}, {value:'buyer', label:'Buyer', desc:'Recycling company or processor — browse and purchase verified recovered materials.', Icon:Recycle}, {value:'weigher', label:'Weigher', desc:'Neutral third party — weigh waste and confirm its value before sale.', Icon:Scale}. Update the import line to bring in Package, Scale (add to the existing lucide-react import) and type `LucideIcon`; type `RoleOption.Icon` as `LucideIcon` (fixes TS2322 on roleOptions). (b) Replace `isRecycler` with `isBuyer = form.role === 'buyer'`; update the company-fields conditional to `{isBuyer && ...}`; rename the local `recyclerProfile` const to `buyerProfile` and type it `BuyerProfile | undefined`; change the `register({...})` call to pass `buyerProfile`; update the type import from `RecyclerProfile` to `BuyerProfile`. (c) Delete the `RESTRICTED` constant and BOTH blocks that reference it (the success-screen 'Approval required' block and the in-form 'restricted role notice' block) — the approval-gating concept is replaced by the FEAT-002 verification step; keep the success screen otherwise. (d) Fix the pre-existing unused-symbol errors: remove `useNavigate` from the react-router-dom import and delete the unused `const navigate = useNavigate()` line (the success screen uses a <Link to='/signin'>); build the register payload as a typed `const payload: RegisterPayload = { ...form, role: form.role as UserRole, buyerProfile }` and call `await register(payload)` so the `RegisterPayload` import is used (remove `UserRole` only if still unused — it is used by RoleOption/FormState, so keep it). (e) Update the company-fields comment 'Recycler company fields' to 'Buyer company fields'. Leave the password-strength, terms, and validation logic unchanged.

19. src/components/auth/ProtectedRoute.tsx and src/App.tsx: NO code change. ProtectedRoute uses `requiredRole.includes(user.role)` with string ids — works unchanged with seller/buyer/weigher. App.tsx routes /dashboard->OverviewPage and /dashboard/market->WasteMarketPage unchanged (OverviewPage now internally routes by role). Just re-confirm they still typecheck after the UserRole change (they will — they reference role generically).
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` exits 0 with zero TypeScript errors (this also fixes the 31 pre-existing baseline errors).

A grep across src/ for `Community Reporter`, `Waste Collector`, `Hub Operator`, `Administrator`, `reporter`, `collector`, `operator` returns no hits used as role identifiers (open-point comment notes are allowed).
AuthContext UserRole is exactly `'seller' | 'buyer' | 'weigher'`; no `admin`/`recycler`/`reporter`/`waste_sourcer`/`hub_operator` role id remains in src.
landingData `roles` has exactly 3 entries (Seller, Buyer, Weigher) and RolesSection renders 3 cards.
RegisterPage roleOptions has exactly 3 roles (Seller, Buyer, Weigher) with descriptions.
DashboardShell ROLE_LABELS and getNavItems cover only seller/buyer/weigher.

Three dashboard files exist (SellerDashboard, BuyerDashboard, WeigherDashboard); OverviewPage renders the correct one by user.role; each is tailored to its role (Seller=listings+credits, Buyer=browse+purchase, Weigher=verification+valuation).
TradingContext exposes `verifyListing` and a 'verified' listing status; a Weigher can verify an available listing and it becomes 'verified' with verifiedWeight/verifiedTotal set.
WasteMarketPage uses seller/buyer/weigher role checks and offers the Weigher a verify action; buyer can express interest on verified listings.
